description:
Explore this 156± acre ranch for sale in Bell County, Texas, offering a great combination of agricultural potential, recreational opportunities, and established improvements. This Central Texas property provides the space, infrastructure, and natural features needed for a working ranch, livestock operation, hunting property, or private country retreat.

The ranch features multiple ponds, a barn and shed, and approximately 40 feet of elevation change, creating a diverse landscape with both functionality and scenic views. With a water meter in place, electricity on the property, and the land being fully fenced and cross-fenced, this ranch is ready for a variety of uses.

Property Highlights

• 156± Acres in Bell County, Texas
• Multiple Ponds Throughout the Property
• Barn and Shed on Property
• Approximately 40± Feet of Elevation Change
• Water Meter in Place
• Electricity on Property
• Fully Fenced and Cross-Fenced
• Ideal for Ranching, Recreation, Livestock, or Investment

Whether you're searching for Bell County land for sale, Texas ranch acreage, hunting land, farm and ranch property, or a recreational ranch in Central Texas, this property offers excellent versatility and opportunity.
